decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program remains close to the mental health core, has a dedicated page, and can be kept at low cost while demand uncertainty resolves.

The carpentry workshop is a related but less central production option whose custom-furniture demand is still uncertain and whose moderate costs keep its option value alive but riskier than care services.
Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to the established care offer and likely inexpensive to run, so the firm continues to hold this pilot option while learning about demand.
The senior-living counseling service is visible on the home page and closely aligned with the eldercare strategy, giving it high option value and a very low drop risk.
Meal delivery for seniors is adjacent to the core offer but still unproven and only mentioned on the website, so the firm keeps it as a low-commitment option while assessing demand.
